correctness.rationale: Rechecked the narrowed theorem in repairs/5/RESULT.md. The Fourier series of exp(-i2x cos theta) yields coherent residue-class aliasing and Parseval gives a unit-mass reference law. Keeping a centered representative leaves only indices of modulus at least ceil(n/2), including even boundary ties. The Poisson integral Bessel bound and (m+j)!>=m! j! give the stated tail T_n; the two tail-square sums each cost at most T_n^2 before division by two, and the cross term costs at most 2B_xT_n. Both columns are probability convolution kernels, so the one-step bound telescopes for every integer t, including zero. The periodic Fourier correlation gives the J_0 multiplier, its x^2 quadratic coefficient, and a strict gap away from frequency zero. Summable Gaussian domination of the centered cyclic Fourier modes gives uniform convergence of scaled site probabilities at every positive diffusive time, followed by a Riemann sum and the flux-uniform comparison. The heat semigroup strictly contracts the norm of its mean-zero deviation, yielding a continuous strictly decreasing profile with the stated limits. Monotone distance to stationarity brackets each mixing threshold uniformly, and the limiting threshold ratios rule out cutoff. The original parity and coefficient calculations also check algebraically: only two opposite winding sectors can contribute at total odd degree n, and the direct and opposite (n-1)-hop pair gives 4(-1)^((n-1)/2) sin(phi) in units of (J tau)^n/(n-1)!. Those statements are not adopted in the repaired claim.
residual_risks: No numerical replay was performed. The recorded 702 checks include tests outside the repaired claim; they are not an independent rerun or an infinite certificate.
The result does not assume mixing at every finite-size parameter choice; the threshold is eventually finite uniformly at each fixed epsilon.
